# UO2热导率研究 / Thermal Conductivity of UO2

二氧化铀(UO2)是轻水反应堆中最重要的核燃料材料。UO2的热导率在300 K时约为8.0 W/(m K)。 Thermal conductivity of UO2 decreases significantly with increasing temperature, reaching approximately 2.5 W/(m K) at 2000 K. UO2的密度为10.97 g/cm^3。

# 热导率模型 / Modeling Approach

热导率可表示为A/(T+B)+CT^D的形式，其中A、B、C、D为拟合参数。 At 1000 K, the specific heat capacity of UO2 is 0.320 J/(g K). UO2的熔点在化学计量条件下为3120 K。The melting point is measured by differential scanning calorimetry (DSC).
